newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: DCC UNIT OPENS BEIJING OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: DCC UNIT OPENS BEIJING OFFICE.

text.p: Irish industrial holding group DCC Plc said on Friday that its subsidiary DCC SerCom Ltd opened a representative office in Beijing, China.

DCC said the office will enable DCC's subsidiary, International Translation and Publishing Ltd, to provide localisation services for the rapidly growing Chinese computer hardware and software markets.

"Localisation involves the conversion of software, help systems and related documentation for foreign language markets," DCC said. "This arises primarily for U.S. software companies who wish to market their products in Europe and Asia."
